cases.question: Can concurrent authorized requests refund one purchase more than once?

sources.label: S1
S2
sources.text: Multiple workers can execute refund concurrently. Database calls each commit independently, without locks or a surrounding transaction. credit is non-idempotent and adds money on every call. No unique refund key is enforced. Users can submit concurrent requests for their own purchases.

cases.question: Can concurrent authorized requests refund one purchase more than once?

sources.label: S1
sources.text:
def refund(user, purchase_id):
    purchase = db.get_owned_purchase(user.id, purchase_id)
    payments.credit_once(key=('refund', purchase_id), account=user.id, amount=purchase.amount)
    db.mark_refunded(purchase_id)

sources.label: S2
sources.text: credit_once atomically inserts the unique key and credits the balance in the same serializable database transaction. The key has a database UNIQUE constraint; a conflicting transaction returns its prior result without crediting again. Keys persist permanently. Purchase IDs are globally unique and immutable.
